title: Desert Campaign (1833–1834)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Desert Campaign (1833–1834)", at revision 1374606403, opens: "The Desert Campaign (1833–1834) was a military campaign in Argentina led by Juan Manuel de Rosas against the indigenous people of the southern Pampas and northern Patagonia. The campaign was later followed by the Conquest of the Desert, which took place in the 1870s and 1880s." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5452877, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1833-1834 Argentinian military campaign". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
